scope.scope: Recorded terminal-foot boundary impulse, not a motor-torque sensor or controller.
scope.alignment: Post-step contact interval(k-1,k], midpoint joint position/normalized mean axis. No fitted delay, torque offset, inertia or gain.
scope.interpretation: Required equivalent ankle-roll boundary axial moment under a finite-interval rigid-body momentum model. Includes unresolved drive/constraint/armature effects; not directly measured actuator torque. No feedback, effort replacement or physical admission.

limitations: Terminal feet have no model descendants; a single-body impulse balance is used. Joint origin/axis come from recorded parent poses and unchanged model frames.
Finite5ms impulses are represented by an equivalent force/couple at the midpoint joint origin with normalized mean axis. Solver-internal application times and moving-axis impulses are unobserved.

Authored inertia, frozen COM/mass and configured gravity retain294 limitations; no effective-live rotor/spatial armature model is available. Armature times raw-velocity difference is only a separately reported scale.
Only intervals with zero enclosing non-foot normal history and wrong resultants are summarized; this does not rule out cancelling/unrecorded external forces.

Approximate PD telemetry is never used in the boundary inverse calculation and is not direct solver/hardware effort. A difference cannot uniquely identify drive, constraint, bias, sampling or inertia cause.
No controller, damping/gain, solver flag, quiet guard, physical criterion or reported effort result is changed. No physical trial/PPO/holdout/video motion is added.
